title: Opposition Makes Progress Toward Ousting Netanyahu, Party Leader Says
summary_full: Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief, has set Dec. 6 as the deadline to form a new Israeli government. His ally, Avigdor Liberman, said Mr. Eisenkot was on track.
